page.title: Reader
page.purpose: Search derived units beside a source region, exposing anchor URIs, confidence, locality, and keyboard traversal.

priorities.statement: A result carries its exact anchor URI and can be selected without a pointer.
Confidence and execution locality are visible on each derived unit.
When semantic retrieval is unavailable, the partial-index state is explicit.

states.description: The reader is ready for a corpus query.
Anchored derived units are shown beside the source region.
Results are available but the semantic retrieval leg is unavailable.
The query failed and the result list returns to an empty state.

claims.statement: The reader exposes a named source region and derived-unit list.
Each displayed result exposes its anchor URI and links the result to a source-region description.
Each result displays a bounded confidence score and a readable Local locality label.
Arrow keys move focus through derived units while preserving the selected source relationship.
Ready, results, partial, and error states are distinct.
